newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end lower on NYSE Thursday fall.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end lower on NYSE Thursday fall.

text.p: Swedish shares dropped on Friday, depressed by negative trends on Wall Street a day earlier. But prices ended off session lows after New York recovered in early Friday trade.
The general index slid 0.96 percent to 2,262.36 in turnover of 4.01 billion crowns.
The bank and insurance sector attracted a lot of attention after banking group Handelsbanken's 23 billion crown bid for mortgage bank Stadshypotek on Thursday.
Although the sector was the strongest, it fell 0.15 percent.
Handelsbanken dropped 1.5 crowns to end at 194.5 crowns after nudging 201 crowns earlier in the day. Stadshypotek ended flat at 188 crowns.
"People are thinking about what this (bid) really means and they are wondering if the state is waiting for a higher one," a dealer said, adding that most players expect it to go through.
The forestry sector was the largest loser, down 1.33 percent on an increase in preliminary Norscan pulp figures on Thursday by 185,000 tonnes according to Swedish pulp producer Sodra.
